title: Medication safety basics
description: General safety principles for using medicines.
content: Use medicines only as directed by the label or a qualified healthcare professional. Ask a pharmacist or clinician about interactions, allergies, side effects, and questions about a medicine. Do not start, stop, share, or change a medicine based only on an online assistant. This prototype does not provide medication or dosage recommendations.

title: Antibiotics: general information
content: Antibiotics are used for certain bacterial infections and do not treat viral infections such as colds or flu. Whether an antibiotic is appropriate is a decision for a licensed healthcare professional. Follow the directions provided for a prescribed medicine and ask the prescriber or pharmacist if you have questions. This assistant cannot recommend a specific antibiotic or dose.
